answer: I would stop farms with Registered IT support technician ticket file with IT support technicians verification, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 629 pays 10064 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The dune sits in the mechanism itself, the ivory sits in the price of faking it, and the jetty sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
